scopeNotes: Single-host multiple JVMs, not a multiple-node cluster. Four samples per mode do not establish p95 or significance.
SQL uses the helper monotonic API-call timer. CPU, GC and heap/RSS summarize sampled JVM lifetime, including setup/probe/shutdown.
Executor peaks denote the largest individual Executor, never the sum of independent peaks. Sampled maxima can miss true peaks.
Proc IO can include waited-for children. Common-live intervals use all three JVM identities together; not exact SQL or connector-local IO.
rchar/wchar include read/write-family operations and are not disk-only or network-only byte counters. Do not sum raw parent/child IO.
Spark spill excludes connector-local sorting/replay; Spark resultSize is not raw commit-message bytes. Isolated encoding CPU is unavailable.
Zero Spark input bytes or OS storage-read bytes does not imply no data was read; custom IO and page cache affect these counters.
